question: A conducting rod of length $0.50\text{ m}$ moves with uniform speed $4.0\text{ m s}^{-1}$ on smooth conducting rails placed in a uniform magnetic field $0.30\text{ T}$ perpendicular to the plane of the rails. The total resistance of the circuit is $3.0\ \Omega$. Calculate the induced emf, induced current, magnetic force opposing the motion, mechanical power supplied and electrical power dissipated.

options.A: $\varepsilon=0.60\text{ V}$, $I=0.20\text{ A}$, $F=3.0\times10^{-3}\text{ N}$, $P_{\text{mech}}=0.012\text{ W}$ and $P_{\text{elec}}=0.12\text{ W}$.
options.B: $\varepsilon=0.06\text{ V}$, $I=0.020\text{ A}$, $F=3.0\times10^{-3}\text{ N}$, $P_{\text{mech}}=0.012\text{ W}$ and $P_{\text{elec}}=0.0012\text{ W}$.
options.C:
$\varepsilon=Blv=0.30\times0.50\times4.0=0.60\text{ V}$.
$I=\dfrac{\varepsilon}{R}=0.20\text{ A}$, $F=BIl=3.0\times10^{-2}\text{ N}$.
$P_{\text{mech}}=Fv=0.12\text{ W}$ and $P_{\text{elec}}=I^2R=0.12\text{ W}$, so mechanical input equals electrical dissipation.
options.D: $\varepsilon=0.60\text{ V}$, $I=3.0\text{ A}$, $F=0.45\text{ N}$, $P_{\text{mech}}=1.8\text{ W}$ and $P_{\text{elec}}=27\text{ W}$.
